name: Magic Broom
effects:
Fifteen single target Fire/Ice/Lightning/NE magic attacks (? each), grants [Instant Cast 1] to party and Awoken Inner Eye Apothecary Mode, [Damage Cap +10000] & [Soul Break Gauge +500] to user
Awoken Inner Eye Apothecary Mode: Unlimited Fire/Ice/Lightning hones, [Quick Fire], [Quick Ice], [Quick Lightning], chases Fire/Ice/Lightning abilities with six single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/NE magic attacks (? each), every 2 chases inflicts [Imperil Fire 10%], [Imperil Ice 10%], [Imperil Lightning 10%]
